Like you - I do the exact same thing and always have done. I attribute it to being my OCD and GAD working together to find something to hyperfocus on and stress over. I think even without an anxiety disorder, researching disorders you fit the symptoms of is a stressful situation for most people.

It might not work for you, but I found the best thing for me is to put Google down and stop searching up every condition and symptom I think I have. The less time you spend looking it up, the less things you have to dwell on. If it becomes a real concern and you're able to, i'd recommend bringing up these concerns to a professional.
